notes.title: Demo Update - Steam Fest!
notes.notes:
With the release of this version, the demo should now feel more complete for Steam Next Fest. Tons of content and rebalancing is on its way but this should give a good idea of the concept - awaiting your feedback!

[h1]Patch notes v1.0.0[/h1]

[list]
[*][h2]Demo Map[/h2]

The map should now feel more lively. Lots of new content. Added extra environmental interactions, which include chests, breakable boxes, sites & capture areas. Feel free to explore and find some surprises.

One of the capture areas will spawn a temporary [b]Book of Sins[/b] that will spin around and periodically cast a fireball - bad for the orcs that happen to be in its way!

[*][h2]Nero The Burner[/h2]

Higher chance to burn its target with the basic attack (16% -> 21%)

[*][h2]Burn[/h2]

If you burn the same enemy multiple times, the damage from the extra instances of burn applied is now increased (20% -> 40%)

[*][h2]Gold Skulls[/h2]

Easier to acquire thus permanent enhancements should be obtainable sooner.

[*][h2]Sound[/h2]

Optimizations and new sounds added.

[*][h2]UI[/h2]

Added extra tabs in the main menu & pause menu. You now have access to a 'Mechanics' tab that gives some extra information about the game mechanics. 

You can also check out the 'Developer' and 'What To Expect?' tabs.

[*][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

The standard routine of fixing stuff. Nothing exciting.

[/list]

That being said, major content releases are coming. Balancing as well. A separate announcement will give more detail information about that.

As usual, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Demo preparation update - Permanent Enhancements!
notes.notes:
The permanent enhancements are now here!

Each run you play will give you some [i]Gold Skulls[/i]. That's the currency you can spend to unlock powerful permanent enhancements!

Those will remain with you...forever. Or at least while [b]'Survive the Orcs'[/b] is open.

Here's a few of those:
[list]
[*]Gain an extra reroll
[*]Healing while at full HP grants you an attack speed buff instead
[*]All sites throughout the map cost 1 gold less
[*]Gold chests are more likely to spawn in your run
[*]Summon a burning tornado after teleporting
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43360168/053030efcf060035c349a4881ebbe1d50555ae67.png[/img]

Of course, pure stats enhancements are also available. More will be added while the demo is being developed. 

Excited to see you in the roguelike world of [b]'Survive the Orcs'[/b]!

Thank you for your support,
Chochosan

notes.title: Demo preparation update - Loading screens & Settings!
notes.notes:
Step by step [b]'Survive the Orcs' demo[/b] is getting closer!

Currently the development focus is set on basic but fundamental features for every game. The latest additions are:
• smooth loading screens between levels
• settings menu with the most important things

[previewyoutube=a4Qz1PKdGB8;full][/previewyoutube]

The audio system has its core fundamentals up & running too, however, there's still a main system to be implemented - the save/load of progress (as well as settings of course).

Once all of these are complete, the main focus will once again shift towards [b]gameplay and balancing[/b]. 

Hopefully the demo will arrive soon to collect your feedback and work towards creating the [b]3D action-roguelike[/b] of your dreams!

Thank you for your support,
Chochosan
